anomalies.description: A physical altercation erupts among players and staff near the basket, involving multiple individuals pushing, shoving, and grappling; referees and coaches intervene to separate the parties.

A large-scale physical altercation erupts on the basketball court involving multiple players, coaches, and officials. Individuals are seen shoving, grabbing, and grappling in a chaotic cluster near the basket, with referees actively intervening to separate combatants.

The incident escalates into collective violent unrest: a dense crowd of players, staff, and officials converges violently around the basket area, with multiple simultaneous physical confrontations, pushing, and attempts to restrain individuals. The scene shows loss of order and coordinated (though chaotic) group aggression beyond isolated fighting.

A large-scale physical altercation involving multiple players, coaches, and officials on the basketball court sideline; individuals are seen shoving, grabbing, and grappling in a chaotic cluster, with referees actively intervening to separate parties.
A multi-person physical altercation involving players, coaches, and officials on a basketball court sideline; individuals are seen grabbing, pushing, and restraining each other in a chaotic cluster.
